scope: Local testing and operational improvements only. No push, production frontend edits, deployment or live transaction. Existing production governance and custody artifacts remain unchanged.
verdict: 20,000 eligible registered wallets complete both phases. 300 historical pool IDs work with 200 retained pools. 300 active pools are NOT supported: the existing 200-pool cap correctly rejects indexing and cycle start. No capacity limit was silently raised.

fixes.gas: Front compaction now removes IDs 1 through 100, forcing retained IDs to move while preserving the staked pool 0. Both cases assert estimateGas below a local 16M budget and execute with that budget; receipt gas is recorded separately from the estimate.
fixes.diagnostics: Keeper-owned failures use fixed safe codes for wrong chain, unknown state, missing signer/private key and unconfirmed settlement/index writes. Common nonce, replacement and invalid-argument categories are allowlisted; arbitrary messages remain hidden. Signer creation is inside provider cleanup protection.
fixes.retries: All preflight getNetwork/getBlockNumber/getStorage/getCode operations now use bounded retryRead, including candidate proxy/runtime/initializer checks. Contract calls retain existing bounded retries. Tests inject transient network, block, storage and code-read failures.
fixes.safeFiles: Safe JSON writes use exclusive wx creation. Added unexpected Safe-address rejection and overwrite-preservation regressions.
fixes.evidence: New uniquely named evidence logs/status files, report and manifest use exclusive creation. The old validation runner delegates to the append-only runner. Old report generators now refuse to overwrite existing files. Existing historical records were left as found in this follow-up; earlier overwritten versions have not been recovered or fabricated.
fixes.repeatability: Added opt-in workflow_dispatch full_collection_scale job using a local Hardhat network only. The test harness is never a production deployment candidate.

scale.methodology: Real original OliveNFT, OliveAssembly proxy, migrated staking and AnnualGovernanceV2 proxy. Two initial wallets hold 100 OBN each. 19,998 additional clone wallet actors each receive one reserve-minted NFT and stake 1 OBN through normal contract calls, then deposit their NFT. No storage injection or fabricated checkpoints. Actor setup is batched 10 per transaction and voting 100 per transaction. This exercises smart-contract wallet participation and global counts, not 20,000 browser sessions or 20,000 separate registration blocks. It does not benchmark public mint economics or real wallet providers.
scale.snapshot: A registered actor withdraws after cycle start; live registration falls to 19,999, snapshot remains 20,000, and the actor successfully votes with frozen 1 VP in both phases.

gas.qualification: Estimates and receipts from measured local scenarios, not a formal upper bound or confirmation of current Base gas limits. The 20k run starts with its pool index already prepared.

validation.frontend: Not changed or revalidated in this follow-up.

failedDevelopmentRuns.reason: Initial test harness failed compilation because a parameter used reserved Solidity keyword assembly. Renamed to vault and reran successfully; failed log retained.

remaining: If 300 simultaneously active pools are required, a separate capacity/gas design change is necessary; current release supports at most 200 retained pools and 100 nonprofits.
Commit the complete reviewed release before publishing its workflow.
Integrate with the current live frontend and preserve independent Oliver changes, then perform production build and actual wallet/device tests.
Use a reliable dedicated release RPC and re-run preflight before signing and after the Timelock delay.
Safe signing, deployment, production configuration, builder attribution and independent formal verification were not performed.
